newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 7.

text.p: -- Intel Corp said it expects strong fourth quarter earnings. Intel shares closed at 109-7/8.

-- Texaco Inc said it suspended two employees and cut the benefits of two others who were allegedly involved in meetings where the destruction of documents pertaining to a discrimination lawsuit against the company was discussed. Texaco shares rose 1-1/4 to 95-7/8 on Wednesday.
-- Ford Motor Co said it cut its North American fourth quarter production forecast by 30,000 vehicles, to 1,045,000, to adjust for production losses.
Ford said component shortages hurt production of several car lines -- Thunderbirds, Cougars, Mustangs, Crown Victorias and Grand Marquis -- and Econoline vans. Shares closed at 31-5/8.

-- Etec Systems Inc said the shipment of some systems had been delayed into the fiscal second quarter, begun November 2. It said it expects first quarter revenues of $43-$45 million, up from $24.7 million a year ago. Shares closed at 25-13/16.
-- Banyan Systems Inc set a restructuring plan and said it would cut up to 15 percent of its workforce. Shares closed at four.
